history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration implement the best practices and lessons learned, focusing on, among others, regional strategies and synergies with other United Nations entities, to draw on successful experiences from the reform in order to inform and improve its work in the future.
history.administration_response: In 2021, the Department of Political and Peacebuilding Affairs and the Department of Peace Operations completed a review of good practices and challenges in planning and decision-making on the establishment of co-deployed special political missions and peacekeeping operations. Furthermore, an immediate priority is the work related to the implementation of regional strategies, an important element of the reform, as noted in the report of the Secretary-General on the review of the implementation of peace and security reform (A/75/202, para. 26), and one of the reform’s objectives. In this regard, the Department of Political and Peacebuilding Affairs conducted a scoping exercise, together with the Department of Peace Operations and the Development Coordination Office, on the development and implementation of regional strategies since the reform of the peace and security pillar. In view of the partnership with the Office in the development of this exercise, the report also covered another reform objective: closer collaboration with development actors. It should also be noted that several detailed experiences and lessons learned from the peace and security reform were included in the report of the Secretary-General. Moreover, all regional divisions are encouraged to establish arrangements for routinely engaging thematic and policy offices in the pillar so as to support analysis, strategy development and knowledge-sharing going forward. Closure of this recommendation is requested.
history.board_assessment: Given that the relevant actions have been taken by the Administration, the Board considers this recommendation implemented.
